title: Feature record
description: Logical schema of one row in a sample-dataset Parquet file (feature version 2.0.0). Every module shares these interval and instrument columns; module-specific feature columns and their Parquet types are listed in the Feature Catalog module pages. Null means unavailable, never zero.

start_time_utc.description: Inclusive interval start, UTC (Parquet timestamp[us, tz=UTC]). Matches the file-name label.

end_time_utc.description: Exclusive interval end, UTC (Parquet timestamp[us, tz=UTC]). The time at which the record's information is complete.

additionalProperties.description: Module-specific feature column; see the Feature Catalog.
